Maya CSM: Quick heads-up  SummitWave EBR next Tue 11am PT. Need a single-slide playbook (flow + 3 bullets) and a live action ticker for follow-ups. Draft slides in drive ~v0.2.
Ethan SE: I can handle demo choreography. Plan: 1 main demo + 1 micro-fallback (local assets). Keep each demo <=4m.
Ravi AM: We need a 30s renewal snapshot for execs. Health slipped ~6% after onboarding backlog and one billing dispute. Can someone pull the top reason codes?
Olga Enablement: I'll create the live ticker template and capture enablement asks. Proposing a 20-min dry run Mon 3pm to assign owners.
deploybot: Uploaded: https://drive.redwood.com/summitwave/ebr_v0.2  comments on slide 1.
Maya CSM: Ethan add slide note: "Fallback: use quantized model if p95 > 300ms" (one line). Also add a recorded GIF fallback.
Ethan SE: ack. Will add step-by-step notes and an offline GIF. Also prepping a 60s smoke test script.
Ravi AM: Quick risk bullets: (1) onboarding backlog, (2) SLA gap on ingest, (3) billing dispute. I'll paste a 2-line exec blurb with mitigations.
Olga Enablement: Ticker template: `Owner | Task | Due | Priority | Status | Follow-up owner | Confidence`. I'll make owners editable, execs view-only. Adding a "Severity" tag column.
Maya CSM: Timeline: slides polished Mon 10am, dry run Mon 3pm, ticker live in deck, exec intro: 45s health + 90s roadmap. Flag conflicts now.
Ravi AM: I have a conflict at 3pm  will upload a 90s voice blurb with my exec line.
Ethan SE: I'll bring the laptop and preload local fallbacks. Tagging @eng-runtime for 1-2 bullets on perf variance for slide notes.
Olga Enablement: Live ticker link: https://sheets.redwood.com/summitwave-ebr-actions  populating rows and pinging owners now.
Maya CSM: Great progress. After dry run we'll triage actions by priority and set SLAs. Thanks team :rocket:
